text:
simon: Heads-up — samplekit's helper adapter is failing schema validation for tool/function calling when SDK is in compact-json mode. Repro steps below, stack trace attached.
anya: ugh, seen something similar. Is this the adapter that strips "\n" and converts pretty JSON to one-liners?
simon: yeah. compact-json removes trailing spaces and newlines, then our schema strictness (required fields order check) trips on arrays formatted inline.
lee: can you paste the failing payload? maybe it's a validator mismatch between zod schema and runtime parser
simon: sure — minimal failing snippet:
```{"action":"create_ticket","params":[{"title":"Login failure","tags":[]}]}```
ci-bot: build 4421 failed on devex/samplekit — validation error: "expected object property order mismatch" (see build logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/4421)
anya: hmm the schema expects {action: string, params: object[]} with params items as objects with explicit keys, but compact-json sometimes serializes empty arrays as [] vs [ {} ]? odd.
lee: quick hack idea: update SDK helper to always pretty-print tool outputs when json-mode=compact is off, but keep compact when enabled and add a tolerant parsing path in adapter.
simon: we tried tolerant parsing (loose-coerce) but it introduced subtle regressions for downstream evals — some tests expected strict typing.
anya: propose adding a lightweight preprocessing step in samplekit adapter: if json parse fails, run a second pass with JSON5 relaxed parser and normalize arrays to explicit empty objects where schema expects objects.
simon: +1. Will prototype. If folks agree, I'll open a small PR and a failing unit test to lock behavior.
lee: +1 from me. also add a short note in the SDK changelog: "compact-json: preserves semantics, adapter will tolerate empty/inline arrays for tool results" :memo:
ci-bot: PR template reminder: include a changelog line and run `yarn test:unit --filter samplekit` before requesting review :robot_face:
anya: thanks. Simon, ping me when PR is up — I can help craft the unit tests around toolcall/schema edgecases. :thumbsup:
